summary.text: Adriane Johnson is a Democratic member of the Illinois Senate for the 30th District, serving since 2020, according to the Illinois General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Johnson's legislature biography says Johnson was appointed to the Senate in 2020, lives in Buffalo Grove, and holds a bachelor's degree from Columbia College and a Master of Jurisprudence from Loyola University Chicago School of Law.
It says Johnson served on the Buffalo Grove Park District Board of Commissioners, including as president, for more than ten years, and as past chair of the Illinois Association of Park Districts.
